name: SQL Dojo
description: Practice the LeetCode SQL 50 inside DBX with a real PostgreSQL 18.6 engine (PGlite 0.5.13) running locally. No server, no setup, works offline. Per-question hints, result-set based grading, and importable custom question banks validated by execution.
releaseNotes: 0.4.3: custom question banks. Download a template from Question Bank Management, write your own questions, and import them as a file or pasted JSON. Every question is executed against the local PostgreSQL engine on import; statements that fail or return no rows are rejected with a per-question reason. The header gains a Custom filter for imported questions, and an empty Custom category shows a short guide with a button to the bank manager. Switching categories now also switches the question shown on the right, and the interface copy has been rewritten in formal wording. Local-only: no database connection, no network.

zh-CN.name: SQL 练习场
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 里练习力扣高频 SQL 50 题。内置真正的 PostgreSQL 18.6 引擎（PGlite 0.5.13），离线可用、无需配置数据库。每题带考察点标签和思路提示，按结果集判题；支持导入自定义题库，导入前逐题实际执行验证。
